apps.name: Hex Code Getter
apps.subtitle: Color to your heart's content- accurately.
apps.localizedDescription:
Hex Code Getter allows you to make any character into a ready-to-use color palette. Add a character from your photo library, a search by name, or a Wikipedia article — the app automatically removes the background, finds the dominant colors, and hands you clean #RRGGBB hex codes you can tap to copy.

Perfect for artists, designers, cosplayers, and anyone who wants a character's exact colors without eyedropping by hand.

Features
• Add characters from a photo, a web image search by name, or a Wikipedia link
• Automatic background removal so only the character's colors are detected
• Dominant-color extraction into a tidy hex palette, with copy-ready #RRGGBB codes
• Filter palettes by color family — reds, blues, greens, browns, and more
• Fast, on-device color analysis

versions.localizedDescription:
Hex Code Getter turns any character into a copy-ready color palette — automatically. It's all on one simple page: your character library, each entry showing clean #RRGGBB hex codes you can tap to copy.

What's included:
• Three ways to add — pick a photo from your library, search by name for a web image, or paste a Wikipedia article, and the app builds the palette for you.
• Automatic background removal — only the character's own colors are detected, not whatever was behind it.
• Dominant-color extraction — the key colors are pulled out and handed to you as copy-ready #RRGGBB hex codes.
• A searchable single-page library — everything you add lives in one place with its palette on the card; search to jump to any character, and edit to rename or remove.
• Fast, on-device color analysis — no accounts, no uploads.

More coming soon!

apps.name: Goose Clicker
apps.subtitle: Who's really more important?
apps.localizedDescription:
Goose Clicker is a simple idle game about one alarmingly productive goose.

Tap the goose to grow your shareholder value — that's the whole business plan.

Free-range, ethically ambiguous, wildly profitable.

versions.localizedDescription:
The goose has the value, not the eggs.

What's included:
• Tap to earn — every tap on the goose lays a golden egg and bumps your Shareholder Value by one, with a satisfying little "+1" that floats up off the bird.
• A one-time origin story — the first time you open the app, a short cutscene explains how it all began (spoiler: it began with 3 eggs).
• Springy, tactile feedback — the goose squishes and bounces on every tap, backed by sound and haptics you can mute anytime from the speaker button.
• Ever-rotating goose wisdom — a rotating cast of one-liners keeps the goose company at the bottom of the screen.
• Your progress is safe — Shareholder Value saves automatically and is right where you left it next time you open up.

Just you, the goose, and shareholder eggs. More is on the way.

apps.name: Custom Watch Faces
apps.subtitle: Customize your Apple Watch!
apps.localizedDescription:
Custom Watch Faces brings a bespoke, always-on face to your Apple Watch. Open the app to display a full-screen animated watch face designed to stay lit while it's on your wrist.

• A clean, full-screen animated watch face
• Built to stay awake while you glance down
• Lightweight and simple to use

A fun, personalized way to give your Apple Watch a fresh look.

versions.localizedDescription:
Custom Watch Faces puts a collection of 8 handcrafted analog faces on your Apple Watch — no design tools or tinkering required. Install the app on your iPhone and it automatically delivers a companion app to your paired Apple Watch, where you pick a face and keep it on screen like a real watch face.

What's included:
• 8 built-in faces — Steampunk, Lily Pad, Ripple, Radiance, Cyber, Linen, Proper, and Kitty — each with its own color palette, hand style, and dial treatment.
• Day-and-date display on faces that support it, so you always know the date at a glance.
• Always-legible analog hands designed to stay readable in bright light and in the Always-On dimmed state.

Getting set up:
• Illustrated, step-by-step instructions walk you through installing the face on your watch and switching to it.
• Clear "Return to Clock" guidance so your chosen face behaves like a true watch face after your wrist drops, instead of closing like an ordinary app.

This is the first public release. Thanks for installing — more faces and refinements are on the way.

apps.name: Lock Screen Sound
apps.subtitle: Play a sound whenever your phone locks.
apps.localizedDescription:
Lock Screen Sound plays a sound effect every time you lock your iPhone (or the screen turns off).

Pick from many built-in sounds and preview any of them with a tap. Leave the app running and every lock plays your chosen sound.

Features
• Fifteen synthesized sound effects — no downloads or audio files
• Use any sound effect of your choosing with a simple MP3 import
• One-tap preview to hear a sound before you pick it

Note: app must be open and running in the background to play the lock sound.

versions.localizedDescription:
Lock Screen Sound plays a sound effect every time you lock your phone. It's all on one simple page: your current sound front and center with a one-tap test, and the full sound list a tap away.

What's included:
• Three kinds of sounds — synthesized classic tones (Beep, Chime, Coin, Power Down, Alarm), ready-made effects (Level Up, Twinkle, Success), and some funny picks (Car Horn, Spring Jump, Explosion, Metal Pipe, Fah, Sus, Hello There).
• Tap to preview — every sound plays a sample the moment you select it, so you always know what you're setting.
• Bring your own — import any MP3 right from the app, then rename or remove it whenever you like.
• Pin your favorites — swipe to pin up to three sounds to the top of the list so they're always one tap away.
• A simple home screen — your current sound sits front and center; tap it to open the full list, or hit Test to hear it on demand.
• Always on, automatically — monitoring starts the moment you open the app; just keep it running in the background and it'll play your sound each time your phone locks.
